resources.string: Find the MAC on the \'BLE Scan\' page; the target must be advertising / connectable — the system will not probe a nonexistent or unreachable address for us.
Not connected — enter the target MAC and tap \'Connect\'; the target must be advertising / connectable
Discovering services — wait up to 10 seconds
Device exposed no accessible GATT services — try pairing in system Bluetooth and reconnect
Service table unavailable — resolve the alert above and reconnect
Property acronyms: R read · W write with response · WNR write without response · N notify · I indicate · BC broadcast · SW signed write · EP extended properties.
No log yet — connect, read, write and notify events will be recorded here
The target must be advertising / connectable; devices already held by another host usually reject a new GATT connection.
Some devices require pairing in system Bluetooth before encrypted characteristics can be read; without pairing they may return insufficient authentication (status=5).
Writes really change device state and may actuate hardware; this page offers no undo — confirm the characteristic semantics before writing.
Read / write / subscribe share one GATT request queue — only one request at a time; a new request is rejected while the previous one is pending.
Characteristic values are raw bytes from system callbacks: never read shows \"--\", an empty read shows \"(empty)\", and text is shown only when decodable as UTF-8.
No semantic guessing beyond standard UUIDs: hex in the log is raw device data and does not imply a parsed business meaning.
Android 12+ connections need the Nearby Devices permission (BLUETOOTH_CONNECT); the app permission gateway handles the request.
[!] Writes really change target state with no undo; confirm the characteristic semantics before writing.
